$comment: A general 'what would I want a skill for day to day' manifest, distinct from trellis-manifest.json (Trellis's specific gaps). Point pipeline 2 at it with --ledger <second file> --manifest general-manifest.json. Kept to 4 broad needs on purpose: with RELEVANCE_FLOOR=0.25, a single-purpose skill matching one need lands exactly at the floor (0.25) and proceeds; a finer split (7 needs -> 1/7 = 0.14) rejects every single-purpose skill at gate A and produces no shortlist. Terms are matched \b-prefixed, case-insensitive, against the first 4000 chars of each SKILL.md.
